How to use this page

Check this page first if you want the fastest overview of which 2026 session is currently actionable.

Use it together with the registration and results pages so you do not separate exam timing from the rest of the application route.

The December session is expected, but do not plan around a specific day until csca.cn publishes one.

After timing, move into preparation

The calendar tells you when action is possible. The next step is connecting that date to subjects, mock work, practice, and a realistic exam plan.
